title: Strong fit, metric-heavy long resume
purpose: A candidate who demonstrates six of seven JD skills with supported numbers. Tests that demonstrated skills are not flagged and that supported numbers survive ATS rewriting.

inputs.job_description:
Data Engineer - Northbeam Analytics (synthetic)

We are hiring a Data Engineer to build and maintain batch data pipelines.

Required qualifications:
- Strong Python skills for building data pipelines.
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query tuning.
- Experience orchestrating workflows with Apache Airflow.
- Experience packaging services with Docker.
- Working knowledge of AWS for storage and compute.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience writing automated tests with pytest.

Optional extras:
- Familiarity with Kubernetes is a nice bonus.
inputs.resume_text:
SYNTHETIC CANDIDATE ONE
Data Engineer

EXPERIENCE
Data Engineer, Harborline Retail (synthetic) | 2021-2024
- Built 12 Apache Airflow DAGs that load retail sales data into PostgreSQL every night.
- Reduced the nightly load time from 90 minutes to 25 minutes by rewriting slow PostgreSQL queries and adding indexes.
- Wrote Python ingestion code that processes about 2 million rows per day from vendor files.
- Containerized the ingestion jobs with Docker so that the same image runs locally and in AWS.
- Cut monthly AWS storage cost by 30% by moving old files to cheaper storage classes.

Junior Data Analyst, Brightpath Logistics (synthetic) | 2019-2021
- Automated weekly reports with Python scripts and reduced manual reporting time by 6 hours per week.
- Wrote pytest tests for the report scripts and ran them in a continuous integration job.

PROJECTS
Pipeline Monitoring Dashboard | 2023
- Built a small Python service that reads Airflow run history from PostgreSQL and flags failed runs.
- Added unit tests with pytest covering 15 failure cases.

SKILLS
Python, PostgreSQL, Apache Airflow, Docker, AWS, pytest, Git

EDUCATION
B.Tech in Computer Science, Example Institute of Technology | 2015-2019
